categories.main_business_segments: Jilin Jinguang Electric Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main business segments: intelligent power grid equipment, new energy charging and swapping equipment, and energy storage systems. The company provides integrated solutions including R&D, manufacturing, engineering design, construction, and operation maintenance for urban and community power supply. It also operates charging stations and offers energy storage products and solutions for power generation, grid, and commercial users.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as gas-insulated switchgear (C-GIS), intelligent metering with 4G/5G, NB-IoT, LoRa communication technologies, AI algorithms for smart charging robots, and liquid cooling for high-power charging piles. Production methods include automated and intelligent manufacturing lines, product lifecycle management (PLM) systems, and project-based R&D management. The company emphasizes digitalization, modular design, and energy-efficient, environmentally friendly technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include national and regional power grid companies, industrial and commercial enterprises, new energy vehicle manufacturers, charging facility operators, and end users of new energy vehicles. The company serves multiple industries such as power generation and distribution, metallurgy, chemical industry, rail transit, urban infrastructure, logistics, and public transportation. Major markets are domestic Chinese regions with growing penetration in Northeast, East, North, Central, Northwest, Southwest, and South China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily across China with significant revenue contributions from Northeast, East, North, Central, Northwest, Southwest, and South China regions. It has production and R&D bases in Changchun, Nanjing, Hangzhou, and Changzhou. The company also actively participates in international exhibitions and promotes products overseas, indicating a strategic push towards international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jilin Jinguang Electric operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the power equipment and new energy supply chain. It manufactures core components and complete sets of intelligent electrical switchgear, smart meters, charging piles, and energy storage systems, and provides integrated engineering and operational services. The company also operates charging stations, positioning itself as both a product supplier and service operator within the ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on 'smart power + digital new energy + integrated services,' emphasizing high-quality, low-cost, and efficient operations. R&D priorities include smart grid equipment, digital and intelligent charging infrastructure, energy storage technology, and integrated energy solutions. It invests in AI, big data, cloud computing, and IoT to enhance product intelligence and operational efficiency. Collaborations with research institutes and universities support innovation and core technology development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of intelligent power grid equipment, new energy charging and swapping devices, and energy storage products. The company also earns income from charging station operations by providing fast charging services to commercial and private new energy vehicles. Additional revenue streams include engineering services, maintenance, and government subsidies related to green energy initiatives.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading supplier in Northeast China with capabilities in medium-voltage gas-insulated switchgear and smart grid equipment. It is recognized as a key supplier to the State Grid and holds multiple patents and certifications. Its subsidiary, Nanjing Nengrui, is a mainstream manufacturer of smart meters and charging equipment in China. The company faces increasing competition in charging pile manufacturing and smart grid sectors but maintains competitive advantages through integrated solutions and technological innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.08 billion, a 5.21% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 333 million. The company’s total assets were about RMB 3.35 billion with net assets of RMB 2.29 billion. Despite short-term profit decline due to market competition and asset impairments, the company continues to invest in R&D and capacity expansion, aiming for sustainable long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jilin Jinguang Electric emphasizes integrated, high-quality, and technologically advanced solutions in smart power distribution, new energy charging, and energy storage. Its products feature digitalization, modularity, environmental friendliness, and AI-enabled smart operation. The company offers full lifecycle services from design to operation, differentiating itself through comprehensive system integration, innovation capabilities, and strong customer relationships with major grid companies and new energy sectors.
